question: The athletes while throwing the discus have to remain inside a circle of how many diameter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.5 meters.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** ****Discus throw** is a t**rack and field event** in which the athlete throws a heavy discus as far as possible.
 
• The discus throw is one of the oldest Olympic events, dating back to ancient Greece.
 
• Essentially, an athlete throws the metal disc by standing inside a **2.5-meter-diameter circle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** discus **has a metallic rim and a circular edge and can be constructed from metal, plastic, fiberglass, or wood. For **men**, it should have a **diameter of 22 cm**, and for **women, 18 cm.**
 
• The **weight of the discus** is fixed at **2kg for the men** and **1kg for women.** 
 
• This **circle is known as the throwing circle or the circle of release.**
